name: Hoshizora Camp
description: Hoshizora Camp — a glamping-site theme laid out like an app: under a full top header, a night-indigo sidebar holds the synced camp board (tonight's sky, free tents, the fire circle, quiet hours and a Book a site button) beside the scrolling page. Tsutsuji azalea pink (#E95295) is the main colour: the header, the hero, every page head and the azalea band are pink fields with night-indigo type. The header splits the menu around the centred camp name, with the Book a site button at its end. The hero is a scene map: a watercolour map of the camp in a white frame with numbered pins for the lodge, tents, domes, star deck, fire circle and creek, and a cut-out bell tent that steps out of the frame and over the hero edge; a cut-out camp lantern hangs over the night band. Every picture is a watercolour illustration. Klee One for display, Gothic A1 for reading. The sample content comes in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-21 (sidebar-app, scene-map hero, split nav, full-illustration images, watercolour, tsutsuji #E95295, Klee One + Gothic A1). Every picture is a watercolour raster illustration generated with Grok Build; break-frame: a cut-out bell tent steps out of the framed site map and over the hero edge, and a cut-out camp lantern hangs over the night band's top edge. Sample content in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de (demo-content.<lang>.json + inc/i18n/<lang>.php + inc/info/<lang>/). Contrast: night indigo #1E1433 on tsutsuji #E95295 5.1:1 (all text on the pink header, hero, page heads and azalea band); night on blush paper #FFF5F8 16.4:1; deep azalea #9B1F57 on paper 7.2:1 (links, labels); paper on deep azalea 7.7:1; dusk violet #5B4A63 on paper 7.6:1 (secondary text); glow pink #F28AB8 on night 7.6:1 (labels, times, prices on the sidebar and night band); pale #F7C8DC on night 11.8:1; paper on night 16.4:1; night on blush #F9D3E3 12.9:1; tsutsuji on night 5.1:1 (sidebar button, footer rule); white on tsutsuji only 3.4:1, never used for text.

fonts.role: display: headings, the camp name, the camp board, times and prices (Latin subset 400/600; a Japanese subset of 600 for Japanese headings)
text: body, labels, navigation, buttons (Latin subset 400/700)

summary.zh-TW: 杜鵑粉的豪華露營地：左側夜藍營地看板，主視覺是水彩營地地圖，去背帳篷跨出畫框；樣本內容含五種語言。
summary.en: An azalea-pink glamping site: a night sidebar camp board, a watercolour site-map hero and a cut-out tent breaking its frame.
summary.ja: つつじ色のグランピング場。夜色のサイドバー掲示板、水彩の場内マップ、枠からはみ出す切り抜きテント。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un glamping rose azalée : tableau du camp en barre latérale, plan aquarelle en héros et tente détourée qui sort du cadre.
summary.de: Azaleenrosa Glamping: Lagertafel in der Seitenleiste, Aquarell-Lageplan als Hero und ein freigestelltes Zelt über dem Rahmen.
